title: Cold rebuild: kill the survivors
summary: Write the loyalty discount tests again from an empty editor, against the same seven mutants.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *Coverage is not enough* you wrote tests that killed every mutant of `Loyalty.Discount`. Write them again from an **empty editor**.

steps.title: Kill the survivors, cold
prompt: `Loyalty.Discount(string tier, decimal total)`: gold gets 10% from 100, 5% below; silver 5% from 100, nothing below; others nothing; rounded half up to the cent; never more than 20.00.
Write `public class LoyaltyTests` with at least 6 tests that kill all seven planted bugs.
